units.personMeanHousingBurden: annual rent / annual household income, averaged over people
units.sampleError: sample mean minus full person mean burden

interpretation: Synthetic CPU model diagnostic. Seed spread is stochastic/generation variation; paired deltas are modeled scenario differences. Resolution comparisons hold represented population and district capacities fixed. Display-sample errors are observed within-model selection errors, not empirical sampling bias.
limitations: No empirical calibration, forecast coverage or policy causality established.
Six default seeds are a compact convenience ensemble; intervals do not quantify all uncertainty.
Same seed across sizes does not establish matched resident identities; generation quotas, capacities, demand and weighted economy can change.
One day, two synthetic districts, CPU only, render off; no GPU adapter, million-agent or cross-backend claim.
Missing travel observations remain null and are excluded with counts; seeds, not people or trips, are the interval replication unit.

evidence.backend: production Population CPU, sequential, render off
evidence.timingScope: Full model creation, stepping, invariant checks, summaries; excludes replay, source hashing and export. One measurement; not a throughput benchmark.
